Name: Double Caramel Frappuccino
Description: A rich blend of Starbucks Frappuccino roast coffee, milk and ice with buttery caramel flavor, topped with whipped cream and a caramel drizzle. A true indulgence for caramel lovers.

Name: White Chocolate Mocha Frappuccino
Description: A creamy blend of white chocolate sauce and Frappuccino roast coffee, milk and ice, finished with sweetened whipped cream. Indulgently sweet and deliciously smooth.

Name: Espresso Frappuccino
Description: A classic blend of espresso and Frappuccino roast coffee with milk and ice, topped with whipped cream. Bold coffee flavor meets smooth frozen texture.

Name: Java Chip Frappuccino
Description: A blended beverage made with rich Frappuccino chips and mocha sauce, Frappuccino roast coffee, milk, and ice, topped with whipped cream and mocha drizzle.

Name: Caramel Ribbon Crunch Frappuccino
Description: A blend of dark caramel sauce, Frappuccino roast coffee, milk and ice, topped with dark caramel drizzle, whipped cream, caramel sugar and ribbon crunch. A layered Frappuccino to remember.

Name: Strawberry Acai Frappuccino
Description: Sweet strawberry juice with real fruit pieces blended over ice. A vibrant, refreshing Frappuccino bursting with fruit-forward flavor and a beautiful pink hue.

Name: Mocha Frappuccino
Description: Coffee is blended with bittersweet mocha sauce and milk over ice, then topped with sweetened whipped cream. A classic mocha taste in frozen form.

Name: Vanilla Latte
Description: A smooth and creamy espresso-based drink with steamed milk and vanilla syrup. A timeless coffee classic that delights with every sip.

Name: Iced Cafe Latte
Description: Freshly brewed espresso shots combined with cold milk over ice for a refreshing coffee experience. A simple but satisfying chilled latte.
PictureUrl: images/products/A Glass Of Iced Coffee With Milk And Ice Cubes.png

Name: Caramel Latte
Description: Rich espresso combined with velvety steamed milk and buttery caramel syrup. Topped with a light foam for a perfectly balanced caramel coffee experience.

Name: Hazelnut Latte
Description: Smooth espresso meets steamed milk with a generous swirl of hazelnut syrup. A nutty, warm, and comforting latte perfect for any time of day.

Name: Cinnamon Roll Latte
Description: A cozy combination of espresso, steamed milk, cinnamon syrup, and a hint of brown sugar. Like drinking a warm cinnamon roll in a cup.

Name: Oat Milk Latte
Description: A barista-crafted espresso with creamy oat milk, perfectly frothed for a rich texture. The plant-based choice that doesn't compromise on taste.

Name: Lavender Honey Latte
Description: Delicate lavender syrup and golden honey blend with espresso and steamed milk for a floral, naturally sweet latte. A unique and aromatic experience.

Name: White Chocolate Mocha
Description: Espresso with steamed milk and white chocolate-flavored sauce, topped with sweetened whipped cream. A sweet and velvety mocha that satisfies every craving.

Name: Dark Chocolate Mocha
Description: Bold espresso meets deep dark chocolate sauce and steamed milk, finished with whipped cream. An intensely rich and indulgent coffee drink for chocolate lovers.

Name: Salted Caramel Mocha
Description: A blend of espresso, steamed milk, mocha sauce, and toffee nut syrup, topped with whipped cream, caramel drizzle and a sprinkle of sea salt. Sweet, salty, and utterly addictive.

Name: Peppermint Mocha
Description: Espresso with steamed milk, rich mocha sauce and peppermint syrup, topped with whipped cream and dark chocolate curls. A refreshing twist on the classic mocha.

Name: Coconut Mocha
Description: Luscious coconut milk blended with espresso and rich mocha sauce. A tropical take on your favorite mocha with creamy coconut notes in every sip.

Name: Hazelnut Mocha
Description: A dreamy combination of espresso, steamed milk, hazelnut syrup, and chocolate mocha sauce. Rich, nutty, and deeply satisfying for any mocha enthusiast.

Name: Iced Caramel Macchiato
Description: Freshly steamed milk with vanilla-flavored syrup marked with espresso and topped with a caramel drizzle over ice. A beautiful layered iced coffee with caramel sweetness.
PictureUrl: images/products/Caramel Macchiato with Vanilla Cold Foam.png

Name: Hot Caramel Macchiato
Description: Steamed milk sweetened with vanilla syrup, marked with a shot of espresso and finished with a caramel drizzle. The iconic layered drink served warm.

Name: Vanilla Macchiato
Description: Smooth steamed milk layered with vanilla syrup and topped with bold espresso marks. A classic macchiato elevated with a sweet vanilla touch.

Name: Rose Macchiato
Description: A romantic blend of steamed milk, rose syrup, and espresso, finished with edible rose petals. Floral, elegant, and utterly Instagrammable.

Name: Brown Sugar Oat Macchiato
Description: Oat milk shaken with ice, brown sugar syrup and cinnamon, then topped with blonde espresso and a brown sugar syrup swirl. A modern twist on the classic macchiato.

Name: Hazelnut Macchiato
Description: Creamy steamed milk with hazelnut syrup, layered with bold espresso shots and a light foam. A nutty, aromatic macchiato that is impossible to resist.

Name: Iced Matcha Latte
Description: Smooth, premium ceremonial-grade matcha whisked with oat milk and poured over ice. A vibrant green, subtly sweet, and energizing drink with earthy matcha notes.

Name: Hot Matcha Latte
Description: Finely ground green tea matcha whisked into a smooth paste and blended with steamed milk. Earthy, slightly sweet, and full of antioxidants.

Name: Matcha Frappuccino
Description: A creamy frozen blend of matcha green tea, milk, and ice. Topped with sweetened whipped cream for a cool, refreshing treat with a vibrant green color.

Name: Vanilla Matcha Latte
Description: Premium matcha powder blended with creamy steamed milk and a touch of vanilla syrup. A perfectly balanced drink that combines earthy matcha with sweet vanilla.

Name: Matcha Coconut Latte
Description: Ceremonial grade matcha stirred into rich coconut milk over ice. A refreshing, dairy-free tropical take on the classic matcha latte.

Name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
Description: An intensely rich multi-layered chocolate fudge cake made with Belgian dark chocolate ganache, moist sponge layers, and chocolate buttercream. A chocolate lover's dream.

Name: Honey Cake
Description: A soft and fragrant honey sponge cake layered with lightly sweetened cream and a drizzle of pure wildflower honey. Simple, classic, and incredibly comforting.

Name: Blueberry Cheesecake
Description: A velvety New York-style cheesecake on a buttery graham cracker crust, topped with a vibrant fresh blueberry compote. Rich, tangy, and absolutely irresistible.

Name: Carrot Walnut Cake
Description: A moist carrot cake packed with walnuts, warming spices, and topped with a generous layer of smooth cream cheese frosting. A classic comfort cake done right.

Name: Lemon Drizzle Cake
Description: A light and zesty lemon sponge cake soaked with tangy lemon syrup and finished with a lemon glaze. Bright, refreshing, and perfectly balanced between sweet and sour.

Name: Red Velvet Cake
Description: A show-stopping red velvet sponge with layers of rich cocoa flavor, topped with luxurious cream cheese frosting and red velvet crumbs. Bold in color, exquisite in taste.

Name: Tiramisu Cake
Description: Italian-inspired espresso-soaked sponge cake layers with mascarpone cream, generously dusted with premium cocoa powder. An elegant dessert with intense coffee-cream flavors.

Name: Glazed Original Donut
Description: The iconic Krispy Kreme original glazed donut — light, airy yeast dough coated in a perfectly sweet glaze. Warm, melt-in-your-mouth, and simply unforgettable.

Name: Chocolate Sprinkle Donut
Description: A fluffy yeast donut dipped in rich milk chocolate glaze and topped with rainbow sprinkles. Fun, colorful, and deliciously sweet for every chocolate lover.

Name: Strawberry Glazed Donut
Description: A soft and pillowy donut coated in a vibrant strawberry-flavored glaze. Fruity, sweet, and visually stunning with its natural pink color.

Name: Boston Cream Donut
Description: A classic yeast-raised donut filled with silky vanilla custard cream and topped with a rich dark chocolate glaze. A timeless bakery favorite done to perfection.

Name: Cinnamon Sugar Donut
Description: A warm cake donut rolled in a generous coating of cinnamon sugar. Crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy on the inside — a comforting classic anytime.

Name: Double Chocolate Donut
Description: A rich chocolate cake donut dipped in a thick dark chocolate glaze and finished with chocolate sprinkles. For those who believe you can never have too much chocolate.

Name: Greek Salad
Description: A classic Mediterranean salad with fresh tomatoes, crisp cucumbers, red onion, Kalamata olives, and generous chunks of creamy feta cheese, drizzled with extra virgin olive oil.

Name: Caesar Salad
Description: Crisp romaine lettuce tossed in a classic Caesar dressing with golden croutons, shaved Parmesan, and a squeeze of fresh lemon. A timeless salad that never disappoints.

Name: Avocado & Quinoa Salad
Description: Protein-rich quinoa paired with creamy avocado, cherry tomatoes, edamame, cucumber, and a zesty lime-cilantro dressing. A nutritious and filling power salad.

Name: Nicoise Salad
Description: A classic French salad with tuna, hard-boiled eggs, green beans, cherry tomatoes, Nicoise olives, and new potatoes, dressed with a light Dijon vinaigrette.

Name: Roasted Beet & Goat Cheese Salad
Description: Sweet roasted golden and red beets with creamy goat cheese, candied walnuts, arugula, and a honey balsamic dressing. A sophisticated salad with bold flavors and textures.

Name: Watermelon Feta Mint Salad
Description: Refreshing cubes of chilled watermelon paired with creamy feta, fresh mint leaves, and a drizzle of balsamic reduction. A summer salad that is sweet, salty, and cooling.
